neighbours.label: describing how a research instrument (questionnaire, scale, test) was built or how valid and reliable it is, as against 'strong', 'good' or 'constructed' about everyday objects
fire: Anxiety was assessed with a specially constructed questionnaire of twenty items.
The researchers designed a short checklist with high content validity.
Teachers' beliefs were measured using a self-constructed survey instrument.
The scale shows well-documented validity and test-retest reliability.
Data were gathered through a structured questionnaire built from earlier studies.
The new rubric was piloted to check its construct validity before use.

The quiz has strong face validity but its reliability is still unknown.
quiet: The workers constructed a footbridge over the stream in a week.
The researchers designed a short trail through the forest for visitors.
Teachers' lounges were furnished using donated sofas and chairs.
The bakery is known for well-made bread and friendly service.
Data were gathered on a sunny afternoon in the town square.
The new bridge was painted green before it opened to traffic.
